nodes.label: benchmarks workflow
nodes.rationale: Smoke-level gate proving benchmarks/ still compiles and still runs against the current src/ API. It measures nothing - benchmark numbers from a shared CI runner are noise. Triggers on src/** too, because the failure mode is a source change orphaning a benchmark, invisible from the benchmark side of the diff: when the free ask() helper was replaced by ref.ask(), ten suites imported a non-existent export and bun run bench stayed dead for months without one red build (#506).

nodes.label: ACTOR_TS_BENCH_SMOKE single-iteration mode
nodes.rationale: Collapses every case to one unwarmed iteration, so the question is whether each suite still executes - catching wiring that is type-correct but wrong at runtime, which typecheck:bench cannot see. typecheck:bench runs first because it is the stricter check for the missing-barrel-export class (TS2305 even for an uncalled import, which Bun elides at runtime) and costs seconds. timeout-minutes: 15 turns a benchmark that hangs into a red job instead of an hour of runner time.

nodes.label: --exclude=worker on hosted runners
nodes.rationale: Same cause as the quarantined worker-thread multi-node suites (#538): Bun on GitHub's runners cannot respawn functional worker threads after the first, and worker-count-scaling.ts spawns 1, 2, 4, 8 and auto in one process. It runs locally via bun run bench:smoke, and the exclusion shares the quarantine's exit criterion, which nightly-flakes.yml measures.
